storyCards.fact:
Eminem's "Just Lose It" reached #6 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Just Lose It" is a song by American rapper Eminem from his fifth studio album, Encore (2004).

The song peaked at #6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Just Lose It was released in 2004.
